svg.title: Controlled processing with independent admission and output authority
svg.desc: Code admission, confidential execution, conditional key release and a protected output gate are governed independently from the workload.

g.text: Controlled processing: code, environment and output
A conceptual architecture for restricting direct and indirect data access
Releases only after evidence is accepted
Independent governance of policy, admission, keys and release
Authority to develop or run a job does not include authority to change these rules.
Logs, files, model artifacts and service responses all pass through output controls.
Failure to meet policy does not authorize a less protected fallback.
Implementation must define hardware trust, key management and the protection of every connecting channel.
